arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Parse +1:00
r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '1997-07-16T19:20+1:00')
print('Parsed +1:00:')
print('  datetime:', r.fixed[0])
print('  tzinfo:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo)
print('  tzname:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo.tzname(None))
print('  offset:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo.utcoffset(None))

# What does the test expect?
expected = parse.FixedTzOffset(60, '+01:00')
print()
print('Expected FixedTzOffset(60, \"+01:00\"):')
print('  name:', expected.tzname(None))
print('  offset:', expected.utcoffset(None))

# Compare
print()
print('Are they equal?', r.fixed[0].tzinfo == expected)
print('Offsets equal?', r.fixed[0].tzinfo.utcoffset(None) == expected.utcoffset(None))
"
